chunks.excerpt: # Carroll County profile Berryville (county seat) and Eureka Springs are the primary population anchors. Use **official** fair, tourism, and party calendars for dates — do not invent schedules here. ## Debate prep cadence (staff rule) Block **one prep evening per week** from now through the week before any major debate that appears on the Kelly calendar. Protect open minutes for rehearsal, briefing, and travel buffer
# Follow-up - [ ] Confirm debate date + moderator rules - [ ] Book weekly prep evenings on Kelly calendar (Week View) - [ ] Assign local guide for Eureka vs Berryville logistics
# Debate prep series (Carroll) Workbook + Week View should carry authoritative dates. This folder holds speech notes, follow-up, and media pointers once staff creates rows.

# Speech notes - Opening frame: Secretary of State is about fair access and trust for every Arkansan. - Localize with Carroll-specific services (DMV experience, elections integrity) only when verified. - Keep answers short; prep rebuttals on process, not personalities.
# Carroll priority notes - Pair debate prep with county fair / tourism weekends when appropriate. - Route through Week View for windshield-time realism before locking Kelly travel.

# Arkansas county vault Per-county working folders for profiles, events, speeches, and media **metadata** (not large binaries). - Paths are repo-relative (`county-vault/arkansas/{county-slug}/…`). - Run `npm run vault:scaffold` to generate folders for all counties from the fair audit list.
